mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism is active in any macro regime.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1% (the 10th percentile of historical values).

mechanism_narrative: Elevated unemployment rates above 5.0% indicate economic weakness and reduced corporate earnings prospects, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of months where UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in the federal funds rate and increases in unemployment signal a recessionary monetary policy response, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of falling FEDFUNDS and rising UNRATE fails to predict negative returns, with Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, strong housing starts and retail sales indicate sustained consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism is regime-specific to late-cycle conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are not significantly positive in late-cycle expansions when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 50th percentiles (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production indicates expanding manufacturing activity and economic growth, which supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 60% of quarters when INDPRO growth exceeds 1.0% (quarter-over-quarter).

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL year-over-year change above 3.0%) triggers expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of months when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts signal strong residential construction and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days in any macro regime.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds its 50th percentile.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 95.0 (relative to 2017=100) indicates manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of quarters when INDPRO falls below 95.0.
